uneven_dp_cost_model_cause.cost_contract: Current MoeOp multiplies local token count by attention_dp_size=8; independent Replay rank execution does not expose the synchronized sum of actual expert-token counts.
uneven_dp_cost_model_cause.example_scope: Homogeneous simultaneous active prefill ranks, remaining ranks in uniform dummy execution. Source-derived shape examples, not measured schedule reconstruction. ISL1024/8192 exceed graph capture896, so eager DP synchronization keeps unequal counts.
limitations: Actual arrival/rank synchronization and mixed prefill/decode steps may differ from examples.
Draft proposal has separate DP synchronization and is not corrected by a target-prefill ratio.
Graph-mode steps pad counts across ranks and must retain their distinct policy.
uneven_dp_cost_model_cause.future_fix: Grouped-rank step preparation with an explicit global expert-token count separate from local attention tokens. No DP1 substitution, fitted factor, or parallel API added.
